value.rationale: The theorem computes the complete natural integral action of every collineation of any existing finite affine plane in both nonzero homology degrees. The orientation-twisted parallel-class tensor determines characters not recoverable from nonequivariant sphere ranks; translation invariants yield an exact rational quotient-Betti formula with zero at order three but positive values at every larger prime-power order. This is a natural infinite-family equivariant classification, not an arbitrary finite invariant or merely a routine rephrasing of the known wedge.
